system.description:
• You have turned the death arts inward, transforming your own body towards undeath. You are neither fully living nor fully dead — something in between, and growing less alive with each level.
  • Necrotic Touch
  • Make an unarmed attack roll: on a hit, your touch deals 1d6 necrotic damage
  • At 10th level this increases to 2d6
  • Creatures you touch must make a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or have their maximum HP reduced by the damage dealt until a full rest
  • Undying Constitution
  • You do not need to eat, drink, or sleep — 4 hours of trance suffices for full rest benefits
  • Advantage on saves vs poison, disease, and paralysis
  • Detect Undead and Speak with Dead are always prepared and cost no slots
